objective: Fix authenticated AdMob revenue sync 401 when Supabase-gateway-accepted legacy service_role JWT does not byte-match runtime SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Preserve strict JWT signature verification and server-only noncash behavior.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-09 Asia/Manila: owner ran hidden PowerShell JWT claim inspection (role=service_role); authenticated requests to ACTIVE Supabase Edge Function v10 returned JSON 401 Authorized scheduler required. Supabase logs recorded repeated POST 401 for function; code matches GitHub main blob 3996a4e1f225b3799449a844ce7323680217c79b. Function verify_jwt=true, therefore Supabase gateway validated the bearer JWT before reaching function body. No official AdMob snapshot; provider PARTIAL and last_sync_at null. Existing v10 code compares entire bearer token to env key; mismatch causes rejection. Official Supabase auth docs state gateway verifies signature, expiry and same-project signing key.
acceptanceChecks: Preserve verify_jwt=true on production and code contract: gateway signature validation mandatory
Require exact service_role claim and unexpired/not-before timestamp; never trust ordinary bearer claims without verified gateway
Do not compare rotated legitimate service JWT bytes to serviceRole env; keep env key for private database RPC
Reject anon/authenticated/expired/malformed JWT roles; keep fail-closed for Google OAuth/network report failures
Preserve BUKLOD QMP/Finance calculations and no payouts; do not enable unverified scheduler
Run targeted Node tests and PR CI before exact-source production deployment
chosenApproach: Minimal server-only authentication gate: depend on deployed verify_jwt=true Supabase gateway cryptographic validation, then check role and token lifetime; leave private DB admin key in use. Add pure role predicate with Node behavior tests and retain previous AdMob Network Report guard.
selectionRationale: Accepted same-project service-role bearer reached handler but bytewise equality against internal env credential failed; tying caller identity to unrelated current env literal makes rotated credentials cause false 401. Platform signature validation is enforced and authoritative.
alternativeApproaches: Disable JWT verification and trust role in unsigned token: REJECTED, insecure
Reset or print server service-role secret: REJECTED, secret exposure and unnecessary credentials mutation
Continue repeating a verified valid JWT in dashboard: REJECTED, no change to root cause
preserveBehaviors: Existing official AdMob Network report with exact BUKLOD app ID/PHP and completeness guard
No QMP, cash payout, admin access, or finance changes
Service role key remains server-only and is used for admin RPC
Other BUKLOD branches, staging, runtime, mobile app untouched
